free_design.Place: A narrow modern workshop repairing paper parasols, bright daylight through frosted windows and trays of plain wooden ribs.
free_design.Activity: She delicately aligns the ribs of a damaged paper parasol against a circular jig, enjoying the patient work of restoring something protective.
free_design.Pose: Sitting sideways on a tall work stool, leaning just enough toward the jig, right hand pinches one rib into place and left hand steadies the hub, both hands visible; face turns down in a gentle three-quarter angle.
free_design.Framing: Waist-to-knee workshop composition with ample room for both hands and the parasol jig, camera slightly above the table height.
free_design.Outfit: A rust-orange backless halter-knit peplum tunic with an open deep neckline, a narrow waist and two long side slits over charcoal fitted short culottes; simple ankle boots and a small plain utility belt. This is a practical fashion outfit with a distinctive peplum construction, no robes or regalia.
